_comment: Mutation testing scoped to the pure, off-engine diffusion-logic modules covered by the harness suite (npm run test:js). The command runner re-runs the full suite per mutant; coverageAnalysis is off because the command runner has no per-test hooks. The ESM loader (tests/loader.mjs) maps /cultural-diffusion/ to the project root and stubs /core /base-standard, so Stryker's sandbox copy resolves to the mutated sandbox files - no inPlace needed.
